sentences.text: Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitutio  India, for the issuance of Writ of Mandamus, directing the second  respondent to consider the representation dated 18.12.2019 of the  petitioner Company, which was forwarded by the first respondent by  proceeding dated 06.01.2020 and pass orders on merits in accordance  with law within the time fixed by this Court, after giving a person  hearing to the petitioner's Company.

For Petitioner : Mr.H.Arumugam  For Respondents : Mr.M.Rajendran  Central Government Standing Cou  for R1  Mr.K.S.Selvaganesan  Additional Government Pleader  for R2 to R4  ORDER This Writ Petition has been filed for issuance of a writ of Mandamus directing the second respondent to consider the representation, dated 18.12.2019 made by the petitioner Company,
wherein, the petitioner has sought for exemption of the lands belonging to the Company from the Satellite Launching Project or in the alternative, to fix the compensation in line with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2

. When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents 2 to 4 produced the written instruction received from the Special District Revenue Officer, Tiruchendur Taluk, Tuticorin, viz., the fourth respondent.
It is also brought to the notice of this Court that the compensation amount that was fixed, has also been deposited before the District Court, Thoothukudi.
The particulars pertaining to the petitioner covering nearly 100 survey numbers were also placed before this Court.
4. In the light of the above development, the relief as sought for by the petitioner cannot be granted by this Court.

If the petitioner is aggrieved by the compensation amount that has been fixed by the fourth respondent, it is left open to the petitioner to work out its remedy in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
